public_sources.finding: Extensions::insert<T> requires T: Clone + Send + Sync + 'static; Extensions::get<T> requires T: Send + Sync + 'static. This is a canonical http 1.x API page and is semver-compatible with rmcp-v3.1.4's http=1 dependency; the tested trait-bound claim is scoped to the observed 1.4.2 documentation.

The Streamable HTTP service documentation states that the consumed HTTP request leaves http::request::Parts in MCP request Extensions accessible through RequestContext, explicitly shows custom axum/tower extension state being read from parts.extensions, and the exact implementation inserts Parts into request/notification extensions on negotiated stateless, ordinary message, initialize, and stateless request paths.

slice.refined_pattern: For rmcp-v3.1.4 Streamable HTTP only: trusted server-side HTTP authentication middleware may place a Principal value into the incoming http::Request extensions; Principal must satisfy Clone + Send + Sync + 'static for insertion. rmcp preserves the resulting http::request::Parts inside MCP RequestContext extensions, and a tool/server handler can retrieve ctx.extensions.get::<http::request::Parts>() then parts.extensions.get::<Principal>(). Missing Parts or Principal must fail closed. Client _meta remains non-authoritative for identity.
